newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Ford Q2 EPS estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ford Q2 EPS estimates raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst John Kirnan raised his estimate of Ford Motor Co's profits in the second quarter and for the full year. The stock is rated a buy -- the firm's only buy among the Big Three automakers.
-- Kirnan raised his estimates for both periods by $0.10 a share, bringing his second-quarter forecast to $1.70 a share and his full-year forecast to $4.75.
-- In a research report, he said the higher estimates reflected a boost in Ford's capacity to produce the Expedition sport utility vehicle.

-- The stepped-up Expedition output, combined with prospects for an "upbeat" meeting with analysts in Dearborn, Michigan on May 21, gives Ford "a legitimate chance to broach our $40 price target over the next several months," he said.

-- Kirnan said April industry sales data raised some questions about the sustainability of key margins over the next several quarters. Any pronounced weakening in margins in the full-size pickup, sport utility and minivan segments could make Ford vulnerable to falling shy of EPS estimates later this year and into 1998, he said.
-- Ford shares were up 3/8 to 35-3/4 late Tuesday afternoon.
